$comment: Written by /setup-loop: this project's own values. "profile" names a proven stack (loop/profiles/), which is a list of stack blocks (loop/stack/); "stack" lists the blocks itself. Every other key overrides the blocks, which override the defaults in loop/lib/config.mjs; anything left out keeps the value from there. What it adds up to: node loop/scripts/stack.mjs. Check it with: node loop/run.mjs --dry-run
